home.alignmentUp: You've been aligning a bit more with community sentiment lately.
home.alignmentDown: You've been diverging a bit more in recent responses.
home.alignmentFlat: Your alignment has stayed fairly stable lately.
home.alignmentDefault: Answer a few more questions to see your alignment trend.
home.divergenceMoreSupportive: Your responses here are more supportive than the current community average.
home.divergenceMoreOpposed: Your responses here are more opposed than the current community average.
home.divergenceDefault: Your responses here differ from the current community average.
home.buildingStanceHistory: You've started building a stance history. Answer a few more and the line fills in.
home.alignmentNotFixed: Alignment is not fixed. This tracks whether you are drifting toward the regional centre or away from it, month over month.
home.answerFirstQuestion: Answer your first question to start building your stance profile.
home.stancesMovedMinority: Stances that moved into the minority
home.newResponsesAnswered: New responses on questions you answered
home.aggregateSentimentIn: Aggregate sentiment across today's questions in {{region}}.
home.societyPromise: Once the day's questions have responses, this reads the balance back to you in a sentence — which way {{region}} is leaning, and how thin the middle is.
home.mediaSurgePromise: When a story starts running well above its usual volume, it shows up here first — so you can take a position before the coverage peaks.
home.participationPromise: Every position taken feeds the counts here. It is the fastest way to see whether a question is actually live or already settled.
home.whereRegionSits: Where {{region}} sits right now, and where you sit inside it.
home.sampleViewNote: These become your own numbers after five answers — nothing here is guessed for you.
home.minorityViewOn_one: You hold the minority view on {{minority}} of {{comparable}} comparable question.
home.minorityViewOn_other: You hold the minority view on {{minority}} of {{comparable}} comparable questions.
home.alignmentNeedsFiveAnswers: One number for how often you land with your region — and the list of questions where you do not. It needs five answers to mean anything, so it waits until then.
home.topicLinePromise: Every topic you answer in gets a line here: your position, the regional average, and the distance between them. Three answers is enough for the first line to appear.
home.stanceProfilePromise: A plain-language read of how you answer — how strongly you commit, and how widely you range across topics.
home.divergentTopicPromise: The topic where you sit furthest from everyone else — usually the most interesting thing the platform can tell you about yourself.
home.fingerprintFilled: Your position on every topic you've answered, at a glance. No two profiles look alike.
home.fingerprintEmpty: One square per topic, coloured by where you stand. It becomes a shape only you have.
home.signalsUpdating: Signals are updating. Explore shifting topics to see where public sentiment is moving right now.
home.minorityTitle: You may be in the minority
home.minorityBody: Public opinion moved away from your position on a question you answered.
home.opinionShiftTitle: Public opinion moved since you answered
home.opinionShiftBody: The community balance changed on one of your questions.
home.newInTopicsBody: Fresh questions appeared in areas where you've already shared your stance.
home.buildStanceProfileBody: Answer a few more questions to unlock stronger insight about where you stand.
home.takePositionAuthed: Take a position, then see where your region sits.
home.takePositionAnon: Take a position in seconds — see how your region compares.
home.onlyUnansweredQuestions: Only questions you haven't answered. Answered ones clear out once you've seen the result.
home.failedToLoadQuestions: Failed to load questions. Please refresh the page.
home.caughtUp: You're caught up. New questions arrive through the day.
home.proposeQuestionCoachMark: Got a question the world should answer? Propose it here.
